title: A Interior for the Glasshouse
author: Paloma Amberdale
blurb: Mara Nakamura, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
